fact: The machine-readable identity card (first examples 2015, introduced 2016, valid 15 years) has been issued only in individual cases, and as of end 2020 Eritrea was not issuing identity cards; each of the six zobas has kept a digital population register since 2001, with a per-resident identification number.
title: Focus Eritrea: Identity and civil status documents
publisher: Swiss State Secretariat for Migration (SEM), Country Analysis
